summary: Austrian-born Dachau and Buchenwald survivor Bruno Bettelheim faked psychoanalytic credentials, ran Chicago's Orthogenic School from 1944 as a whites-only total institution where he beat children, and blamed autism on cold mothers.
keywords: Individual and Mass Behavior in Extreme Situations

evidence.note: birth in 1903 to a wealthy Viennese Jewish lumber family
arrest after the Anschluss and internment at Dachau, then Buchenwald (both in modern Germany)
1943 camp essay blames Jewish character; long segment on his distortions of camp life
lies about his aesthetics PhD and psychoanalytic credentials
takes over the Orthogenic School in Chicago in 1944
imposes whites-only and Christian-only policy and expels disabled children
former student's account of routine beatings at the school
The Empty Fortress and the refrigerator-mother theory of autism
death of a student on a home visit, which Bettelheim recast as suicide
his 1990 suicide and the wave of survivor accounts that followed

notes: Primary theme child-abuse rather than medical-malpractice: he had no medical or psychology credentials, so the refrigerator-mother theory and invented diagnoses go under quackery-pseudoscience. Survivor accounts continuing to today get only a short coda, so reaches_present is false. main_span starts at the 1938 arrest, whose camp experience shaped his later work.
